name: print-social-yellow-cream-fintech-social-ad-grid
title: Yellow and Cream Fintech Ad Grid
whatItIs: A six-panel grid of square-ish social ads for a global account app: cream and yellow backgrounds with blob shapes, confident portraits of people holding or using the yellow app, floating transfer cards, coin icons and store badges.
whatItMeans: Warm yellow, joyful people and playful shapes make money movement feel optimistic and fast.
techniques: Yellow app screens repeated so the product colour equals the brand colour
Organic blobs in yellow, pink and blue behind subjects
Floating transaction pills overlapping the photos
Headline mixing a light setup line and a heavy punch line
Store badges anchoring the bottom of every ad

vocabulary.definition: An organic rounded shape used behind subjects.
A UI card overlaid on a photo.
A light lead-in line followed by a bold payoff.
